Figure 1. Organization of the biosynthetic gene cluster for grisechelins from Streptomyces sp. SCSIO 40020, HPLC analysis of fermentation profiles,
and structures of isolated compounds. (A) Organization of the grisechelins’ biosynthetic gene cluster from Streptomyces sp. SCSIO 40020. (B)
HPLC analysis of metabolite profiles of (i) S. lividans SBT18/pSET152; (ii) heterologous expression of grsc BGC in S. lividans SBT18; (iii) S.
coelicolor M1154/pSET152; (iv) heterologous expression of grsc BGC in S. coelicolor M1154; (v) S. albus J1074/pSET152; (vi) heterologous
expression of grsc BGC in S. albus J1074. (C) Structures of compounds isolated from heterologous expression strains.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. (A) The proposed biosynthetic pathway of grisechelin F (2). (B) HPLC analysis of metabolite profiles of (i) S. lividans SBT18/pSET152;
(ii) heterologous expression of grsc BGC in S. lividans SBT18; (iii) the Δgrsc19 mutant by insertion mutagenesis. (C) HPLC analysis of metabolite
profiles of (i) S. lividans SBT18/pSET152; (ii) heterologous expression of grsc BGC in S. lividans SBT18; (iii) the Δgrsc60 mutant by insertion
mutagenesis. The black star in trace ii/iii of B and C denotes an unknown compound that is unrelated to grisechelins. pCSGzsl001, Aprr, BAC
plasmid containing entire grsc BGC; pCSGzsl002, pCSGzsl001 derivative where grsc19 was replaced by aadA and oriT; pCSGzsl003, pCSGzsl001
derivative where grsc60 was replaced by aadA and oriT.
